design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER - task 0 (preorders_and_backorders, Marlowe & Finch)

[0] Draw and scope snapshot. `draw_counts.py ... --task 0` printed {"task": 0, "key": "env_0031_online_fashion_retailer/preorders_and_backorders/0", "prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 5]}. Task 1's draw (3 prerequisite problems, factor counts [4, 5, 5, 4]) was printed at the same time for the headroom check. Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0 is first). Claimed here: preorders_ext_made_to_order_work_charge (6 factors, tool confirm_made_to_order_cancellation_940e1e7b, owner=user) and preorders_ext_made_to_order_remake_deposit (5 factors, tool take_made_to_order_remake_13bceb2b, owner=agent). Reserved for task 1 (disjoint): price protection on a Deposit Pre-Order, the Deposit Pre-Order cancellation charge (customer's own confirmation), the made-to-order deposit paid after a declined charge (customer's own payment) and the Deposit Pre-Order replacement deposit - four laws, none restating a ladder of this task. Base gap routed (recorded in the difficulty worklog): every base user act of this product (delay consent, specifications confirmation, request confirmation) carries no number; the customer's confirmation of a cancellation that forfeits a deposit is therefore modelled as the act that books the settlement, its base gates (forfeiture_confirmed, booked_after_cancellation) retired by declared overwrite.

[1] Why this is a good test. The customer asks for one thing - her custom Chelsea boots remade in a US 9. The agent has to discover from the remake policy's prerequisite sentence ("A remake is taken only after the pair it remakes shows status cancelled, its cancellation request confirmed and no deposit left standing on it.") that the pair in production (status in_production, request pending, 151.20 deposit standing) must first be cancelled on the customer's own confirmation, work out a six-factor work charge from three date spans and three other products' records, hand the confirmation to the customer with exact figures, and only then compute a five-factor remake deposit on the settled world, where the work charge just booked is set off. Difficulty comes from reading policy, reading nine record families and arithmetic, never from choosing among similar tools (each policy names exactly one tool).

[2] Problem-tree card. Root: preorders_ext_made_to_order_remake_deposit (agent). Prerequisite: preorders_ext_made_to_order_work_charge (user). Edge R -> U: kind value_input, gate setoff_share (compute binding of the remake), form state, policy_source = the sentence quoted in [1] (four-point test: ordering connective "only after"; waits on record-visible states - reservation status, request status, the deposit standing on the history; names no tool, id or code token; hard requirement, scope = the one pair remade). Exactly one write of this difficulty brings that state about: the customer's confirmation tool is the only write that sets a made-to-order pair to cancelled at the customer's request, marks its request confirmed and books the kept and refunded deposit entries (no other extended policy cancels a made-to-order pair). Derivation: sentence + records (in_production, request pending_customer_confirmation, history = +151.20) + the work-charge rule ("the cancellation is made on the customer's own in-person confirmation of the pending cancellation request ... keeps a work charge ... refunds the rest") -> the customer's confirmation. Unresolved at frozen_time: initial_state.reservations.<mto>.status = in_production; initial_state.reservation_requests.<pending>.request_status = pending_customer_confirmation; initial_state.reservation_events.<capture>.amount_usd = 151.2. Topological order: work charge (step 10) then remake (step 14). Deletion sensitivity (actual run): skipping step 10 makes the remake deposit 118.80 instead of 57.63 and leaves the pair uncancelled. user_scenario never names the cancellation, the request or any amount; cancelling appears only as a passive reaction after the agent explains it. Tools validate nothing (the remake tool copies style, colour, price and owner from the old pair and never reads its status).

[3] Base-invariant card. Work-charge write (subject preorders_production_cancelled, preorders_deposit_forfeited, preorders_deposit_refunded): governing base policy preorders_evt_cancellation_refund; its gates forfeiture_confirmed and booked_after_cancellation are retired by the two declared overwrite clauses (the confirmation, cancellation and entries are one booking); inherited and stated in the rule: after the cutoff (start of production) a made-to-order cancellation keeps money, any delay notice means a full refund (delay_notice_count 0 here, no notice row), refunds go to the original card. No time gate applies. Remake write (subject preorders_reserved, preorders_deposit_captured): governing preorders_reservation (type matches the item state; original ship-by no later than max_initial_ship_by_days = 56 after the reservation date - the rule fixes it at exactly +56, 2026-10-02 + 56 = 2026-11-27; at most 1 unit), preorders_agg_multi_holding (10 open reservations - the customer holds none once the pair is cancelled), preorders_agg_launch_style_limit (Launch only), preorders_evt_deposit (captured once at reservation by card) - none has a structured gate on this subject, so policy_scope in solvability_contract. Overwrite: the base deposit sentence ("The deposit is `deposit_pct` percent of unit price times quantity ... never less than `deposit_min_usd`.") is replaced by the remake deposit sentence.

[4] Business-object card. Target: reservation <mto> (Marlowe & Finch Bespoke Chelsea Boot, MF-418302-BLK-85, US 8.5, R.T., 540.00, in_production). Correlation key: reservation_id, and for the confirmation the pending request id (the two withdrawn requests, of 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-22, are excluded: status withdrawn). Rows aggregated: its single deposit capture (151.20); the three request rows (2026-09-15 withdrawn, 2026-09-22 withdrawn, 2026-09-29 pending; the latest, 2026-09-29, ends the production-stage count and anchors the remake's carry and set-off windows; the withdrawn 2026-09-15 row is a near-miss - read as the date the customer asked to cancel it would give 17 days and the averaged carry and part set-off, read as the stage end 10 days and the cutting share). Cross-product evidence: loyalty membership (Icon, active, enrolled 2019-03-02), loyalty ledger earnings (2826 points in 12 months; the 2025-09-02 earning of 256 is 13 months old and excluded), order lines (5 footwear lines in 24 months; excluded: the 2024-08-20 riding boot at 25 months, two apparel lines, one accessories line), return cases (1 opened in 12 months; excluded: 2025-09-12 at exactly 12 months), Unlimited Standard Annual (active). The remake copies the old pair's style, colour, price and owner; it is linked to the cancelled pair through the remade_reservation_id argument.

[5] Factor card (values from the actual run, labels as judged by the round-1 audit and corrected). Work charge (baseline: price x 0.50, capped at the deposit held, rounded once; on this world 151.20 - equal to base's full forfeiture): production_stage_share (parameter, date; lasting/stitching 0.30; baseline -> 151.20); stage_clock_start (method - it changes the anchor the stage clock starts from; personalised pair confirmed 12 days before production -> count from 2026-09-05, 24 days; baseline count from production start gives 12 days and 63.71 - near-miss: an agent counting from production start lands in the cutting tier); personalisation_multiplier (parameter: a coefficient on the work share; x1.5; baseline 84.95); rewards_tenure_relief (parameter, loyalty; one membership row, tier and enrolment months; x0.60; baseline 151.20); footwear_client_relief (parameter, orders; x0.92; baseline 138.51); return_record_relief (parameter, returns; x0.95; baseline 134.14). Expected 127.43: 5 parameter, 1 method. Remake deposit (baseline: price x deposit_pct 50 / 100, floor 50.00 -> 270.00): paid_percentage_carry (method: carry the paid percentage / average it with deposit_pct / take deposit_pct; 28.00; baseline 176.43); unlimited_plan_reduction (parameter, multi-source over two distinct records: an active Unlimited annual plan on the pass record AND an active Gold-or-above membership on the Marlowe Rewards record; 5 points; baseline 84.63); rewards_points_reduction (parameter, loyalty ledger; 1 point; baseline 63.03); work_charge_setoff (parameter; one condition, days since the customer asked to cancel; 0.40; baseline 118.80); setoff_personalisation_multiplier (parameter: a coefficient on the set-off; x1.2; baseline 67.83). Expected 57.63: 4 parameter, 1 method. Every factor moves the result; each whole baseline differs from gold. Base boundaries kept: cutoff, delay-notice full refund, card-only deposit, floor deposit_min_usd, one unit, 56-day ship-by.

[6] Seed rows and why (each claim checked by a removal run). customers (identity); loyalty membership + 5 earning rows (tenure relief, the Unlimited reduction's tier condition, points reduction - 2826 points in 12 months; the 2025-09-02 earning of 256 is outside the window, and counting it would still give 1 point, so it does not move the tier); 6 orders + 9 order lines (footwear relief: 5 lines in 24 months; the 2024-08-20 riding boot and the accessories belt are outside the count, and counting either would still give x0.92, so they test the reading of the rule without moving the tier); 2 return cases (return relief; the 2025-09-12 one is outside 12 months, and counting it would still give x0.95); Unlimited membership (plan reduction); the made-to-order reservation + its deposit capture + three cancellation requests (two withdrawn, 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-22; one pending, 2026-09-29). The pending request ends the stage count, yet removing it changes neither scored value: the stage end moves to today and the clock still runs from the specifications date (27 days, still the 0.30 tier), and the remake's carry and set-off windows would then run from the withdrawn 2026-09-22 request (10 days, same tiers); the pending request bears weight as the object the customer's confirmation names and sets to confirmed in the terminal state. The withdrawn requests are not the most recent and change neither value. Rows that bear weight: the specifications/production dates, the personalisation, the deposit capture, the membership row, the five in-window footwear lines, the 2026-03-14 return, the pass row and the four in-window earnings. The excluded rows are kept as the history a real profile carries; none of them moves a tier. No unsettled obligation other than the one this task resolves: the 2026-10-27 ship-by is still in the future, so no delay notice is owed at frozen_time. Automatic clauses checked: not a Launch (no authorization renewals); specifications already confirmed (2026-09-05, day 4 of 7); no consent deadline.

[7] Persona. Rosalind Tavares, terse and dry; volunteers only the remake in US 9; gives name + email to be found, mobile number as the second credential (DOB/ZIP held back); answers size, personalisation ("R.T., capital letters with a full stop after each"), colour/style unchanged, and that she does not want to keep the 8.5 pair; reacts passively: agrees to the cancellation only once the agent explains it, runs the confirmation step herself with the figures given, agrees to the card on file for the deposit, accepts the deposit and ship-by date, ends the call once told the new pair is ordered. She knows no amounts, no request, no policy.

[8] Standard solution. find_customers(name, email) -> verify (email + phone) -> find_reservations -> find_reservation_events -> find_reservation_requests -> find_loyalty_memberships -> find_orders -> find_order_lines -> find_return_cases -> unlock + hand over the confirmation tool; the customer calls it with reservation <mto>, request <pending>, work_charge_usd 127.43, deposit_refund_usd 23.77 -> find_pass_memberships -> find_loyalty_ledger -> unlock + call the remake tool with the old pair's number, size "US 9", personalisation "R.T.", deposit_required_usd 57.63, original_ship_by_date 2026-11-27.

[9] Verification (commands actually run from the repo root, outputs pasted). check_extended --task 0: EXTENDED OK. check_task_tools --task 0: TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK. replay_tasks --task 0: "0.json 15 True True 0 29 29 True" REPLAY OK (first run failed: empty-string foreign keys counted as dangling and order payments were outside the read closure -> empty foreign keys now null, payment rows dropped, find_orders added; re-run green). check_solvability --task 0: SOLVABILITY OK. check_compute --task 0: "0.json 2 11 5 8 34 15 True" COMPUTE OK (history rows 8). check_grounding --task 0: GROUNDING OK. check_cross_fire --task 0: SCOPE OK. check_traceability not run: the published KB (docs/) does not exist yet. Authoring evaluation (lib.sensitivity over check_compute.build_env/eval_compute): U result 127.43, factors {production_stage_share 151.2, stage_clock_start 63.71, personalisation_multiplier 84.95, rewards_tenure_relief 151.2, footwear_client_relief 138.51, return_record_relief 134.14}, baseline 151.2, touched 3; R result 57.63, factors {paid_percentage_carry 176.43, unlimited_plan_reduction 84.63, rewards_points_reduction 63.03, work_charge_setoff 118.8, setoff_personalisation_multiplier 67.83}, baseline 270.0, touched 5; R without step 10 = 118.8.

[10] Closure. Policy -> tool -> computation -> call: work charge -> confirm_made_to_order_cancellation_940e1e7b -> computations[0] (step 10, work_charge_usd) -> terminal: reservation cancelled/customer_request, request confirmed, -127.43 forfeited, -23.77 refunded; remake deposit -> take_made_to_order_remake_13bceb2b -> computations[1] (step 14, deposit_required_usd) -> terminal: new Made-to-Order Reservation MF-418302-BLK-90, US 9, R.T., 540.00, deposit 57.63 captured, ship-by 2026-11-27. charter_scope and required_documents list both policies in tree order; task_tools in first-call order.

[11] Easy mistakes and how the records exclude them. Counting the stage from production start (12 days -> 0.15) instead of from the specs date; counting to today instead of to the pending request; taking the withdrawn 2026-09-22 request as the stage end; counting the 2024-08-20 riding boot or the belt as footwear lines; counting the 2025-09-12 return or the 2025-09-02 points; forgetting the cap or the delay-notice check; computing the remake deposit before the cancellation (no set-off -> 118.80) or at deposit_pct 50; applying the floor before the set-off.

[12] Draft recomputation from the visible context (hidden compute/expected masked). From the two policies' prose, the tool docstrings, the records the finders return and the persona's lines: the remake needs the pair cancelled/confirmed/settled -> the customer confirms with the work charge 540 x 0.30 x 1.5 x 0.60 x 0.92 x 0.95 = 127.4292 -> 127.43 (refund 23.77) -> remake deposit 540 x (28 - 5 - 1)% - 0.40 x 1.2 x 127.43 = 57.6336 -> 57.63, ship-by 2026-11-27, size US 9, R.T. - identical to gold.


[13] Rework round 2 (policy-task audit, findings closed). CG-1: personalisation_multiplier and setoff_personalisation_multiplier relabelled parameter (each policy keeps one genuine method: stage_clock_start and paid_percentage_carry). CG-2: the set-off ladder no longer restates the remake's prerequisite (it reads only the days since the customer asked to cancel), and the Unlimited reduction now combines the pass record with the Marlowe Rewards record (annual or monthly plan AND an active Gold-or-above membership), so the task carries a genuine multi-source factor; the Rosalind world sits on it (Standard Annual, Icon). O-14: the stage-clock tier 2 now states its reason (stock-pattern pairs are cut on the day they are ordered). O-3: the paid percentage is 'rounded half up to two decimal places'. Findings 3 (false assertions in [6]) rewritten above with removal-checked claims. A third, earlier withdrawn request (2026-09-15) was added to the pair so the suite history threshold still holds with the trimmed set-off (history rows 9). All scored values are unchanged; the full gate block was re-run and is green (see worklog). O-5 (remake docstring wording), O-16 (excluded rows do not move tiers), O-18 (orders seeded without payment rows: no factor of this task reads payments) and O-19 (find_orders read: kept because the order rows are parents of the counted lines and must be in the read closure) are recorded and left as they are.

[14] Rework round 3 (audit revision_2). R2-1: card [4] said 'the two request rows' after the 2026-09-15 withdrawn request was added in round 2; it now lists the three request rows and records the 2026-09-15 row as the near-miss the audit identified. Charter observations closed in passing: O-22 (unused binding last_request_status removed from the remake deposit compute) and O-21 (price protection states that a regular booking wins a same-day tie with a clearance one). No scored value changed; the full gate block was re-run green.
user_scenario: You are Rosalind Tavares, a graphic designer in Columbus, Ohio, calling Marlowe & Finch customer care about the custom Chelsea boots you ordered at the start of September - the black made-to-order pair with your initials R.T. stamped inside. You ordered them in a US 8.5, and after trying on a pair of the brand's regular boots at a friend's place you are now sure you need a US 9. What you want is simple: you would like the boots remade in a US 9, same black leather, same initials R.T., and you want the agent to set the new pair up for you today. You speak in short, precise sentences, a little dry, and you do not volunteer anything you are not asked. You open by saying you have custom boots on order in the wrong size and would like them remade in a US 9. If the agent needs to find your account, you give your name and the email you sign in with, rosalind.tavares@fastmail.com; if they need more to confirm it is you, you give your mobile number, 6145550166, and only if that is still not enough your date of birth, 1986-04-12, or your billing ZIP code, 43215. You do not remember order or reservation numbers and say so if asked; you leave the agent to look them up. If the agent asks what should change, you say only the size: US 9 instead of US 8.5, everything else exactly as before, and if they ask about the personalisation you repeat that it should read R.T., capital letters with a full stop after each. You do not want to keep the 8.5 pair, and you do not want a different style or colour. If the agent explains that the pair already being made has to be cancelled before a new pair can be ordered, and that part of what you paid is kept because work has started, you sigh, say that is fair enough, and agree. When the agent tells you that you have to confirm that cancellation yourself and hands you the step to do it, you will confirm the cancellation yourself straight away, using exactly the reservation, request and amounts the agent gives you, and you read back what the confirmation shows. If the agent asks whether they may charge the deposit for the new pair to the card on your account, you say yes. When the agent tells you the new pair's deposit and the date it is promised to ship by, you accept them without arguing. Once the agent tells you the new US 9 pair has been ordered, you thank them and end the call.

request_alignment.claim: The customer wants her made-to-order Chelsea boots remade in a US 9 with the same initials, set up by the agent today.
evidence: user_scenario:you would like the boots remade in a US 9, same black leather, same initials R.T., and you want the agent to set the new pair up for you today

gold_actions.business_effect: The in-production pair is cancelled at the customer's request on her own confirmation of her pending request; the work charge is booked as kept from the deposit and the rest is refunded to the card.

request_binding.action_semantics: A remake needs the pair it remakes cancelled and settled; cancelling a made-to-order pair whose production started forfeits part of the deposit, and confirming such a cancellation is the customer's own act, so the customer's agreed confirmation selects this action and no agent-side cancellation.

evidence: user_scenario:you will confirm the cancellation yourself straight away
user_scenario:you will confirm the cancellation yourself straight away

stage_provenance.fact: The cancellation of the pair and the settlement of its deposit happen in this call; before it the pair is in production with its request pending.

base_preconditions.condition: Both gates of this policy on the write (forfeiture_confirmed, booked_after_cancellation) are retired by the work-charge policy's overwrite: the customer's own confirmation of the pending request, the cancellation and the deposit entries are booked together.

gold_actions.business_effect: A new Made-to-Order Reservation remaking the cancelled pair in US 9 with R.T. is taken and its deposit charged to the card.

request_binding.action_semantics: The customer asks for the boots to be remade in another size; a confirmed made-to-order pair cannot change size, so the request selects a remake reservation of the cancelled pair rather than a size change.

evidence: user_scenario:you would like the boots remade in a US 9
user_scenario:you would like the boots remade in a US 9

stage_provenance.fact: The pair being remade stands cancelled with its request confirmed and its deposit settled, established by the customer's confirmation.

base_preconditions.condition: A Made-to-Order Reservation is taken for an item built to the customer's confirmed size and personalisation, for one unit, with an original ship-by date no later than 56 days after the reservation date and a card deposit.
The customer may hold up to max_open_reservations_per_customer (10) open reservations; after the cancellation she holds none.
The per-style launch limit applies to Launch Pre-Orders only; a Made-to-Order remake is outside it.
The deposit is captured once, at reservation, by card.

required_user_inputs.information: Name and sign-in email to locate the profile

required_user_inputs.source: user_scenario:it should read R.T., capital letters with a full stop after each

required_user_inputs.information: Permission to charge the remake deposit to the card on the account
required_user_inputs.source: user_scenario:If the agent asks whether they may charge the deposit for the new pair to the card on your account, you say yes.

required_user_inputs.information: Whether she wants to keep the 8.5 pair (she does not)
required_user_inputs.source: user_scenario:You do not want to keep the 8.5 pair

seed_consistency.check: Made-to-Order Reservation reserved 2026-09-01, specifications (US 8.5, personalisation R.T.) confirmed 2026-09-05 = day 4 of the 7-day window, production started 2026-09-17 (status in_production, so the customer cutoff has passed); original and current ship-by 2026-10-27 = reservation date + 56 (max_initial_ship_by_days); no delay notice (delay_notice_count 0); deposit 151.20 = 28 percent of 540.00, the made-to-order deposit the deposit policy gives an Icon member enrolled 2019 at reservation (30 percent less 2 points for 5 footwear lines in the 24 months before 2026-09-01; no captured spend on record, so no spend reduction), never below deposit_min_usd 50.00.
Deposit captured once, at reservation 2026-09-01, by card_or_wallet, amount equal to the reservation's deposit_required_usd 151.20; no refund, forfeiture or application yet.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's profile by the name and sign-in email she states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed by the customer reference number this returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Confirm the caller owns the profile with two stated credentials (email and mobile number).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Account details may not be discussed or changed before identity is confirmed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's reservations: the made-to-order Chelsea boot pair, its status in_production, price, personalisation R.T., reservation, specifications and production dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Price, personalisation and the three dates decide the work share, the clock start and the personalisation multiplier of the work charge, and the status shows the pair is not yet cancelled (the remake prerequisite).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the pair's history: the deposit of 151.20 captured, no delay notice.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The deposit held caps the work charge and is the base of the refund and of the paid percentage the remake carries; the absence of a delay notice means a work charge applies.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the cancellation requests on the pair: two withdrawn (2026-09-15, 2026-09-22) and one pending confirmation (2026-09-29).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The pending request is the end of the production-stage count and the object the customer confirms; its date also starts the remake set-off and carry windows. It shows the pair's cancellation is still unconfirmed (prerequisite unmet).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Marlowe Rewards membership: Icon, active, enrolled 2019-03-02.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Tier and enrolment date decide the tenure relief on the work charge.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's orders: six orders, all delivered and closed, none cancelled.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every booked line the footwear-client relief counts belongs to one of these orders; reading them lets the agent match each footwear line to an order of the customer's own (the relief counts lines booked on the customer's orders). No order is cancelled, so no line is set aside.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the order lines booked on the customer's orders with their dates and product classes.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The count of footwear lines booked in the last 24 months decides the footwear-client relief.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the return authorizations on the profile with their opened dates.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The count opened in the last 12 months decides the return-record relief.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the customer's own cancellation-confirmation tool and hand it to her.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; confirming a cancellation that forfeits deposit is the customer's own act; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The customer confirms her pending cancellation request: the pair becomes cancelled (customer_request), the work charge is booked as kept and the rest of the deposit refunded to her card.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: preorders_ext_made_to_order_work_charge computes work_charge_usd; the remake waits on this cancelled-and-settled state.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.reservation_id: 50c6c903-e704-4059-ae59-0bd461c3fc6c. Basis: the reservation lookup (find_reservations by the verified customer) returns the one Made-to-Order Reservation of the profile, style Marlowe & Finch Bespoke Chelsea Boot, size US 8.5, status in_production; the customer asks about 'custom boots on order in the wrong size'. Uniqueness: it is the customer's only reservation, so no other reservation number fits.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.reservation_request_id: a4db185c-4cae-4b02-97f5-9f6abf36727d. Basis: the request lookup for that reservation returns three cancellation_with_forfeiture requests; the work-charge rule turns on 'the customer's most recent cancellation request on the reservation when that request is still pending confirmation', and the tool docstring asks for 'the customer's pending cancellation request for that pair'. Uniqueness: d28056db-4cfa-4910-a68e-2fe8af54d640 (created 2026-09-15) and b591716a-457c-46a9-bd7e-0c8bf8b0913c (created 2026-09-22) are withdrawn; only a4db185c-4cae-4b02-97f5-9f6abf36727d (created 2026-09-29) is pending_customer_confirmation.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.work_charge_usd: 127.43. price 540.00 x 1 = 540.00; production stage counted from the specifications confirmation date 2026-09-05 (personalised pair R.T., specifications confirmed 12 days before production started 2026-09-17, >= cut_ahead_days 10) to the pending request date 2026-09-29 = 24 days -> lasting/stitching work share 0.30; production days to today 2026-09-17 -> 2026-10-02 = 15 >= 7 with personalisation -> x1.5; active Marlowe Rewards Icon enrolled 2019-03-02 (91 months >= 36) -> x0.60; 5 footwear lines booked in the last 24 months (2025-11-15, 2026-02-09, 2026-04-28, 2026-08-11 x2; the 2024-08-20 riding boot is 25 months old) -> x0.92; 1 return authorization opened in the last 12 months (2026-03-14; the 2025-09-12 one is 12 full months old) -> x0.95; no delay notice. 540 x 0.30 x 1.5 x 0.60 x 0.92 x 0.95 = 127.4292, below the deposit held 151.20, rounded half up -> 127.43.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.deposit_refund_usd: 23.77. Basis: 'the refund of the rest is the deposit held less the work charge'; the deposit held is the sum of the reservation history = 151.20 (one deposit capture, nothing else). 151.20 - 127.43 = 23.77.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Unlimited membership: Unlimited Standard Annual, active.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: An active Unlimited plan held by a Gold-or-above member takes percentage points off the remake deposit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the points ledger with posting dates and event types.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Points earned on orders and posted in the last 12 months decide the points reduction on the remake deposit.
First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Take the remake: a new Made-to-Order Reservation for the same boot in US 9 with R.T., at the cancelled pair's price, with its deposit charged to the card.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: preorders_ext_made_to_order_remake_deposit computes deposit_required_usd on the world after the cancellation of step 10.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.remade_reservation_id: 50c6c903-e704-4059-ae59-0bd461c3fc6c. Basis: the remake rule: 'A remake is a new Made-to-Order Reservation taken for the style of a Made-to-Order pair the customer has cancelled'; the docstring asks for 'the reservation number of the cancelled made-to-order pair being remade'. Uniqueness: the only cancelled made-to-order pair on the profile after step 10.

edges.condition: The remade pair's reservations.status is cancelled, its most recent reservation_requests row has request_status confirmed, and its reservation_events amounts sum to 0.00 (the work charge kept and the refund of the rest are both booked).
edges.policy_source: A remake is taken only after the pair it remakes shows status cancelled, its cancellation request confirmed and no deposit left standing on it.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: At frozen_time the pair is still in production, its latest cancellation request is pending the customer's confirmation, and the full deposit of 151.20 stands on it, so it is neither cancelled, nor confirmed, nor settled.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The customer's confirmation (step 10) sets the reservation to cancelled, the request to confirmed, and books -127.43 kept and -23.77 refunded, so the history sums to 0.00; the work charge kept now stands as a forfeited entry, so the set-off subtracts its share instead of nothing.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge: the cancellation-and-settlement write must precede the remake (the remake's prerequisite sentence and its set-off read the settled pair); there are no parallel prerequisites to order.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the customer's confirmation leaves the pair in production with its request pending: the remake deposit recomputes to 118.80 instead of 57.63 (no work charge kept, so nothing to set off), and the terminal state lacks the cancellation, the confirmed request and both deposit entries.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario raises only the remake ('you would like the boots remade in a US 9'). It never mentions the pending request, the cancellation, the work charge or any amount; cancelling the current pair appears only as a passive reaction conditioned on the agent explaining it ('If the agent explains that the pair already being made has to be cancelled ...').
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: take_made_to_order_remake_13bceb2b reads the remade pair only to copy its style, colour, price and owner and never checks its status, its request or its deposit; it writes the remake whatever the state of the old pair. confirm_made_to_order_cancellation_940e1e7b cancels and books whatever amounts it is given. Neither returns an error for an unmet prerequisite.
